answer: Proof of replication storage ties each identity to its own sealed data. At registration an agent must seal a 50 GB replica with a key-specific, slow encoding, like a trellis that cannot be reused across keys, then answer random spot checks on 16 chunks within seconds. Honest agents pay once; 1,000 fakes need 50 TB of uniquely sealed storage and weeks of sealing, so cost grows per identity and cannot be pooled in one vault or sold as shared nectar.
